title: IAM least privilege
prompt: What does an AWS IAM permissions boundary do?
choices: It sets the maximum permissions an identity policy can grant
It grants every action inside the boundary
It replaces the need for a role trust policy
answer: It sets the maximum permissions an identity policy can grant
explanation: IAM documents a permissions boundary as a managed policy that limits the permissions identity-based policies can grant. It does not itself grant permissions. Least privilege means starting from the actions a task needs.
